Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Football 2026 U17 WWC: Seidatu Wahab wins Player of the Match against Canada Source : GFA 25 October 2026 5:08pm Audio By Carbonatix
Midfielder Seidatu Wahab was named Player of the Match after an outstanding performance in Ghana's crucial 2-0 victory over Canada at the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
Wahab was the engine room of the Black Maidens side, breaking up play, winning duels, and keeping Ghana ticking with her composure on the ball.
While goals from substitutes Linda Achiaa and Christiana Ashiaku grabbed the headlines, it was Wahab's tireless work in midfield that allowed Ghana to dominate proceedings and secure the win that sent them through to the Round of 16.
Partnering Jessica Appiah in the middle of the park, Wahab screened the back four superbly, denying Canada any space to play, and was instrumental in launching Ghana's attacks.
Her standout moment came in the first half with a perfectly timed last-ditch tackle to deny Canada a clear goalscoring opportunity, before playing a key role in the build-up to Ghana's opener.
The award caps a strong tournament for Wahab, who has grown in stature with each game, from the defeat to Norway, to the thrilling 3-3 draw with Brazil, and now the vital win over Canada.
The Black Maidens will now turn their attention to the Round of 16, where Wahab will again be crucial to Coach Nana Joe Adarkwa's plans.
